# Northwind Telecom — Prepaid plans

*Synthetic document. Northwind Telecom is a fictional operator invented for testing; every figure
below is made up and describes no real product, tariff or person.*

## How prepaid works

A prepaid connection is paid for before it is used. You buy a pack, the pack's validity starts the
moment it is applied, and the connection stops carrying traffic when the validity ends. Nothing is
invoiced afterwards and there is no security deposit.

## The packs

| Pack | Price | Validity | Daily data | Voice | SMS |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter 149 | ₹149 | 24 days | 1 GB | Unlimited on-network | 100 / day |
| Value 299 | ₹299 | 28 days | 2 GB | Unlimited any network | 100 / day |
| Heavy 499 | ₹499 | 56 days | 3 GB | Unlimited any network | 100 / day |
| Annual 2999 | ₹2,999 | 365 days | 2.5 GB | Unlimited any network | 100 / day |

Daily data is a daily allowance, not a pool: unused gigabytes do not carry into the next day. Once
the daily allowance is spent, browsing continues at 64 kbps until midnight at no extra charge.

## Data add-ons

An add-on tops up the current pack without changing its validity. The ₹19 add-on carries 1 GB and
expires at the end of the day it is bought. The ₹58 add-on carries 3 GB and expires with the
underlying pack. Add-ons cannot be bought on a connection whose pack has already lapsed.

## Grace period

When a pack lapses, the number is held for 15 days. Incoming calls stop immediately, but the number
can be recovered by applying any new pack within those 15 days. After day 15 the number returns to
the numbering pool and cannot be recovered.

## Changing packs

A new pack can be applied at any time. If the running pack still has validity left, the new pack is
queued and starts when the current one ends. A queued pack can be cancelled from the app until it
starts; once it starts it follows the refund policy.
